text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — prepping Acme onboarding QBR and I noticed activation env spend jumped after last week's embed rollout. Can we sanity-check token econ + set up a feedback loop for prompts? cc @Jordan Lee @Priya Narayanan
Jordan Lee: On it. Can you drop the acct id + exact timeframe?
Maya Patel: acct_acme_001, window 2026-03-10 -> 2026-03-17. Spike ~3x baseline. I put a quick sheet here: https://redwood.internal/sheets/acme-activation-spend (view only) :eyes:
Priya Narayanan: Thanks — likely batching + rerank fanout. I can audit prompt templates and sampling for that week. Any heavy rerank jobs in their workflow?
Liam O'Connor: I had a budget alert but threshold was set to monthly not daily. Lowered it to daily and added a digest. Should surface anomalies sooner.
Jordan Lee: Pulling token burn now. Quick query I ran locally: ```sql
SELECT customer_id, DATE(ts) dt, SUM(prompt_tokens+completion_tokens) tokens
FROM analytics.tokens
WHERE customer_id='acct_acme_001' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-17'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY dt;
```
Jordan Lee: Results show major bump on 2026-03-13 — +210% tokens, correlated with 40% more requests and 3x avg tokens per req.
Maya Patel: That matches their support note about a bulk import on the 13th. They used the embed endpoint to index ~200k items.
Priya Narayanan: If they pinged embed for each item with high context in the prompt that's the culprit. Suggest: backfill with batching (batch_size=512) + switch to the streaming embed path for large imports.
Liam O'Connor: Logged an action: lower cost by recommending quantized model for embed-heavy jobs and enable prefix-KV caching for repeated contexts.
Jordan Lee: I'll draft the spend notes for the QBR: delta, root cause, short-term mitigations (batching + lower threshold), long-term runbook (ingest best-practices).
Maya Patel: Also want to capture customer feedback on onboarding docs — they said the embed example didn't warn about per-item calls. Can we add a small advisory to the quickstart?
Priya Narayanan: I'll update the onboarding snippet and add a highlighted callout: "For large imports, batch requests and consider streaming or deduped contexts."
deploy-bot: Automated alert: billing-threshold-triggered acct_acme_001 at 2026-03-13T03:12:04Z — spike flagged by anomaly-detector:v2
Liam O'Connor: For the QBR, we should include a small cost-savings estimate. Jordan, can you add an ops delta: expected monthly tokens saved if they adopt batching & quantized model?
Jordan Lee: Yep — will compute and attach numbers by EOD. Rough ballpark: batching -> ~60% token reduction during ingest windows; quantization -> additional ~20% per-token cpu cost cut.
Maya Patel: Great. Action items: Jordan = cost delta + slide, Priya = doc update + sample code, Liam = alert tighten + runbook snippet. I'll schedule a 30m enablement sync with Acme next Tue.
Priya Narayanan: Sample code I'll add to the doc (cc to Maya). quick snippet: ```python
# batch embed example
for i in range(0, len(items), 512):
    batch = items[i:i+512]
    client.embeddings.create(model='embed-lite', input=batch)
```
Maya Patel: Perfect. Also capturing Acme feedback in the product tracker: https://redwood.internal/feedback/acme-001 — please drop notes after you draft.
Jordan Lee: Dropping a quick table into the QBR deck and tagging this thread. :thumbsup:
Liam O'Connor: I'll add a daily alert and a sample runbook step for CS to escalate next time.
Maya Patel: Thanks team — closing loop. Will share the QBR draft tomorrow for review. :raised_hands:
